name: ToolPilot
conditions: A link back to toolpilot.ai is mandatory for all free listings — you must place one of their badges or logos on your site and then fill in the badge URL or email them to confirm
The badge requirement 'will help prioritize your submission' — i.e., free listings without it may not be processed

sources.title: ToolPilot 'Submit Your AI Tool' page — mandatory backlink notice and submission form
ToolPilot brand guidelines — badge downloads, footer badge instructions, contact form fields

requirements: Product must be an AI-powered tool
Free listings must carry the 'Powered by ToolPilot.ai' or 'Featured on ToolPilot' badge linking back to toolpilot.ai
Contact/submit form fields: Name, Email, Name of AI Tool, Company/Organization Name, Website, AI Tool Description, Comment
preparation: Badge asset from https://www.toolpilot.ai/pages/brand-guidelines (featured badge black/white, or logo pack)
A footer/site location where the badge can link to toolpilot.ai or your ToolPilot listing page
Tool name, company name, website URL, and a written tool description
A contact email for the confirmation step
workflow: Add the ToolPilot badge/logo to your site footer first (required before or alongside the free submission)
Include the URL of the page where your badge is placed, or email contact@toolpilot.ai to confirm the badge
Wait for the ToolPilot team to review and create the listing
watchFor: The site is Shopify-based; the submit page shows a 'Pricing Table' heading whose contents did not render in fetched HTML — paid tiers/featured options exist but amounts are unverified
Badge should link 'to ToolPilot.ai, or directly to your page on our site' per brand guidelines
The badge verification is manual — you must tell them the URL or email them; forgetting this step stalls the free listing
countsAsLive: A public product page at toolpilot.ai/products/<handle> appearing in collections such as 'New AI Tools' or a category listing
unknowns: Exact paid pricing tiers — the pricing table on the submit page did not render its content
Whether a Shopify customer account (Login link) is required to complete the submit form
